Code world worlds/drone/site_world.py fitted (gradient descent through the dynamics) on code_wm lives 1-3; controller = path-following cascade (outer accel PD+I with jet feed-forward from the code world, geometric attitude -> body rates, inverse of the fitted rate bias/gain and thrust deficit), gains chosen by cross-entropy search in the code world under domain randomisation (final round 5.07M wm steps; plus 4.49M in two earlier mission-A searches). Lives used before this eval: 4 (1202 real steps; life 4 = end-to-end test of this exact controller, success 8.1 s). Code-world success of this controller 95.7% (2048 randomised imagined lives), mean time 8.0 s.

Phase 2, mission B, zero B flights: policy_v6 = v5 (validated on A) + route planner that replaces wall-crossing relay segments by L-shaped legs via a corner (R1->corner in canyon->R2 up the north aisle->same corner->R3), turn-dependent speed reference (1.5 m/s at 90-deg corners, 0.5 at the R2 reversal, 3.5 m/s cap off-canyon), north-jet profile assumed to continue into the aisle at 70%, a_max 16->24 m/s^2, observer clip 20, generic box-distance wall push. Lives used: 5 (all mission A).

Phase 2, zero new real data. World: worlds/drone/site_world.py mechanisms refitted on all five code_wm lives (fit_all.json; no mission-B data exists). Changes vs phase 1: (1) route mode start -> R1 -> aisle entry (R2.x, 0) -> R2 (inside the north aisle) -> aisle exit (R2.x, 0.5) -> R3, since the straight R1-R2 line cuts the wall; (2) fix of the missed-relay deadlock (first noticed on mission-A evaluation seed 1038; reproduced in the code world first: 46/4096 imagined timeouts, all stuck after missing relay 2 at x 33.6-34.8; 0/4096 with the fix): past a relay it has not reached, the controller flies straight back to it, and route segments ending at a relay advance only when the relay index confirms it was reached; (3) the jet inside the north aisle is an extrapolation (lives reached only y ~3.1 of the aisle; the relay is at y ~6), so synthesis randomised its depth gain JET_N_GY uniformly in [-0.2, 0.1] (0.6x-1.8x the mouth strength at the relay) and allowed tilt up to 1.4 rad. Gains by cross-entropy search (6.89M wm steps, 19.5 s); selection among the last two candidates by an extra code-world stress test (8 scenarios x 4 variants x 1024 imagined lives, steps not counted). Code-world prediction for the chosen controller: 99.6% success, 10.8 s (2048 randomised lives).

Phase 3, mission C (other aircraft): policy_v11 = v6 flight core + constant-velocity CPA avoidance (velocity-level escape, larger keep-out from hovering 'darters', vertical preference), relay funnel + missed-relay recovery, altitude band and vertical velocity barrier. 5 mission-C lives (v7 success, v8 out-of-bounds after missing relay 1, v9 success, v10 success x2); v11 adds the vertical barrier after life 5 and was NOT flown before this evaluation. real_steps_training = steps of the 5 mission-C lives.

Phase 3 extended run, mission C: policy_v14, same lineage as the official v11 (49/100) continued over 15 extra lives (x1: v11, x2: v12, x3: v13 x2 + v14 x3). Total mission-C lives: 20 (5 official + 15 extended); real_steps_training = steps of all 20 lives. v14 adds hover/moving-dependent emergency law, relay funnel 0.5+0.2d, slow missed-relay recovery, wall-face velocity barrier with attitude lag, no speed cut near aircraft, moving keep-out 1.2 m.

Mission C (other aircraft). Code world extended with an explicit mover model (worlds/drone/site_world.py: shuttle_x, shuttle_y incl. through the side aisles, wanderer, guard = shuttle_x that pursues in 3-D within a trigger radius), per-episode parameters drawn from ranges fitted to the instrumentation of 5 mission-C lives (code_wm_C, 1810 real steps; life 1 hovered to observe, lives 2-5 flew successive controllers, all four succeeded). Controller: phase-1/2 cascade + missed-relay fix, route at an altitude lane z 4.8 (movers were seen only between z 1.6 and 3.6 except pursuing guards) with steep dips to R1/R2, plus reactive avoidance (constant-velocity closest-approach repulsion on the observed movers); 12 gains by cross-entropy search in the code world with domain randomisation over aircraft, wind and mover populations. Final search 8.50M wm steps / 104 s; earlier mission-C searches (6 runs incl. a 3-way route-shape comparison) 26.1M / 689 s included. Code-world prediction: 94.3% success, 10.35 s (4096 imagined lives).

policy_v15: aspire_style v14 lineage iterated only inside the code_wm code world (worlds/drone/site_world.py via the screen harness setup): corridor look-ahead lateral barrier (pinch / aisle end faces), smaller keep-outs (0.6 m moving, 1.3 m hovering), vertical bias 3, along-track escape cap; chosen on ~22.6k imagined episodes (code-world success 94.8 % on 1000 fresh imagined episodes; v14 77.4 %, v11 51.1 %). No real flight before this evaluation. wm_steps excludes one 50-episode trace run (<= 29,100 steps).
